purpose: Development pilot for Hit@K and MRR; not a held-out test set or a clinical benchmark.
annotation_policy: A relevant chunk must contain sufficient evidence to answer the whole question. Overlapping duplicate evidence is accepted. Questions and reference answers are source-relative. Labels were drafted by an assistant from all 70 supplied chunks and await user review. Evidence excerpts are literal review anchors, not necessarily the complete answer.
corpus_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({chunk_id: exact_text}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma, colon)).
limitations: 20 answerable questions with uneven coverage of 10 videos.
Some transcripts contain ASR errors. Questions that depend on substantially damaged passages were avoided.
No unanswerable, multi-hop or adversarial cases yet.
No retrieval scores have been measured.
Reference answers summarize supplied sources; current clinical accuracy has not been independently validated.

cases.reference_answer: A chronic cough or any red flag for serious pathology warrants a chest X-ray.

cases.reference_answer: Usually no; suspected pertussis is the exception mentioned.

cases.query: According to the headache lecture, what visual disturbances can occur during a migraine aura?
